_readme: Said by the hooks once the Keeper is beaten and the lantern is still dark.
It repeats the WHOLE remaining objective on purpose. This line outranks warden_has_key
forever, so anything only that line said - the lantern, the oil, the hermit, the cave east
of the town - would be permanently unreachable for a player who went straight in and won.
A conditional line that can be outranked must carry the facts of the one it outranks.

heard.speaker: Warden
heard.text: You went in. And you came out.

quiet.speaker: Warden
quiet.text: Then the keep is only a building again. It wants a light - and that lantern ran dry years ago. The hermit in the cave east of the town hoards oil by the flask. Light it, and I will believe it.
